description: Abstract class for alarm node handling in Thingsboard rule engine, managing alarm processing, script execution, and message transformation.

classes.name: TbAbstractAlarmNode
classes.description: Abstract class for alarm nodes in the rule engine, handling alarm processing and message creation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the alarm node with configuration and script engine.

methods.name: loadAlarmNodeConfig
methods.description: Abstract method to load specific alarm node configuration.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages and processes alarms accordingly.

methods.name: processAlarm
methods.description: Abstract method to process alarm logic asynchronously.

methods.name: buildAlarmDetails
methods.description: Builds alarm details JSON asynchronously using scripting engine.

methods.name: toAlarmMsg
methods.description: Converts alarm result into a message for transmission.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, particularly the script engine.

methods.name: tellNext
methods.description: Enqueues the next message based on alarm processing outcome.
